purpose: Read-only retrospective diagnostic; not a replacement for frozen historical acceptance reports or a new physical rerun.

tracking_protocol.window: latest pre-goal odometry plus all odometry received through acquisition_finished; actual first/last source times, no extrapolation
tracking_protocol.reference: first nonempty path received after goal, frozen by receipt order, ignoring path header time
tracking_protocol.integral: sqrt(sum(dt*(error_i^2+error_i+1^2)/2)/sum(dt)); finite discrete trapezoid approximation, not continuous true-error guarantee
tracking_protocol.unknown: missing/invalid fields, conflicting same-stamp poses, source rollback, insufficient span or coverage, gaps>0.5s, missing explicit frame contract
tracking_protocol.percentiles: nearest-rank P95/max of unique observed source-pose errors, not time-weighted or continuous extrema

frame_contract.name: otter_fake_localization
frame_contract.scope: Only the audited otter fake-localization project: map->odom is identity; this does not establish identity for arbitrary recorded data.

verified_sources.identity_evidence: Default zero translation and rotation.w=1; map_frame to odom_frame; odom header frame at line 114.

frame_contract.version_scope: These are the audited baseline/e381 implementations and logs. For later source versions the explicit caller assertion requires confirming this unchanged transform contract; matching frame strings alone is not proof.

method.zero_baseline_rule: exactly zero cpp: ratio=null; pass iff abs(python)<=atol
method.p99_aggregation: mean/max of reported per-trial P99, not a pooled sample percentile
method.performance_scope: Python non-fault navigation trials only; control P99<100ms, mapping P95<=observed scan-period P50, independently evidenced stable backlog; unknown is not passed
method.backlog_rule: at least 3 same-epoch snapshots and 2 consecutive approximately-5s intervals, boundary coverage, balanced counters and integration progress; sustained overflow fails; legacy sparse gauges retain recovery rule; new post_drain_latency_v1 additionally requires dense 80%-covered 5s windows, bounded wall-time waiting and identity turnover, without requiring an empty queue; recurrent TF expiry is unknown and isolated expiry only recorded
method.cpu: 100*sum(nonnegative same-PID cpu_seconds deltas)/sum(positive same-PID process.monotonic deltas); not machine CPU and excludes planner child/Gazebo
method.thruster_variation: sum(abs(command[i]-command[i-1])) per axis in full recorded JSONL order; no initial/final zero appended; total requires all axes and >=2 valid samples each
method.counter_scope: final reported cumulative counters per completed trial, not sums of status event counters

decomposition_definition: Along-route progress is x-23.125 for straight, -y-10.125 for turn. Assign each complete observed source-time trapezoid to the bin of its midpoint progress (<3,3..9,>=9m). All intervals are retained, including tiny negative initial progress; energies sum exactly. Spatial boundary assignment is a diagnostic discretization, not a new acceptance score.
reference_definition: Reconstruct preview pose from latest received published trajectory and its 0.5s pose spacing. Python query is state-source age plus configured preview; C++ uses fixed relative preview and ignores its erroneous published absolute header. This is not proof of which asynchronous callback/reference actually produced each command.
